quotes.speaker: Iman Shumpert
quotes.summary_phrase: Los Angeles Clippers face severe draft pick losses and penalties
quotes.excerpt: The Los Angeles Clippers, as it stands, will lose 5 first-round draft picks starting in 2029
quotes.quote: The Los Angeles Clippers, as it stands, will lose 5 first-round draft picks starting in 2029 on top of numerous fines and suspensions, and the Kawhi Leonard trade to Toronto has still not been executed since it was first agreed to. But I am receiving news that that actually has gone through completely now.

quotes.speaker: Iman Shumpert
quotes.summary_phrase: Clippers are years away from being championship contenders
quotes.excerpt: The Clippers are down probably about 15 years, not going to lie.
quotes.quote: The Clippers are down probably about 15 years, not going to lie. And I mean 15 years before the championship hunt. With all these daps, fines, suspensions, all the things that are happening, we cannot erase the fact that y'all already traded y'all shit before y'all lost this. Y'all already gave all y'all shit up. And now y'all get hit with a double whammy right now. So I ain't going to lie, it's going to hurt. Darius Garland, enjoy yourself in LA. I don't think it's going to be a lot of winning.

quotes.speaker: Iman Shumpert
quotes.summary_phrase: Clippers face a difficult uphill climb to remain competitive
quotes.excerpt: It's going to be tough sledding. All uphill.

text_blocks.speaker: Iman Shumpert
text_blocks.text: It's going to be tough sledding.

text_blocks.speaker: Arhii Shumpert
text_blocks.text: It's going to be tough sledding. It's going to be tough sledding. All uphill. All uphill, so get ready. All uphill. For real.

quotes.speaker: Iman Shumpert
quotes.summary_phrase: Clippers need patience and fan support to rebuild
quotes.excerpt: To improve their team though, I think it's just going to be a matter of patience.
quotes.quote: To improve their team though, I think it's just going to be a matter of patience. They're going to have to have a fan base that really has their back and goes through the fire with them. This is also an owner that broke the rules. So if I was a free agent knowing y'all just got hit with a fine and you're going to just pay the 30 and you went under the table to get Kawhi Leonard just to try and get a championship, y'all were unsuccessful. If I'm a free agent, I would want to go in with my selling point being, I'll get you that championship.

quotes.speaker: Iman Shumpert
quotes.summary_phrase: Clippers are handcuffed by their financial and draft situation
quotes.excerpt: What if after this, they come back and they're like, man, we handcuffed? Like we want to.

text_blocks.speaker: Arhii Shumpert
text_blocks.text: What if after this, they come back and they're like, man, we handcuffed? Like we want to, but now we legit can't. And all eyes on us.

text_blocks.speaker: Iman Shumpert
text_blocks.text: No, no, no. We talking about billionaires. We talking about billionaires here. I want to win. If I want to win, Kawhi Leonard didn't get a ring with them. Kawhi was hurt.

quotes.speaker: Iman Shumpert
quotes.summary_phrase: Clippers need to get creative with their financial resources
quotes.excerpt: They're going to have to get creative, but you think a billionaire ain't creative?
quotes.quote: They're going to have to get creative, but you think a billionaire ain't creative? Come on man, we got crypto now. Give them a crypto card. Hand them a crypto card. It's encrypted anyway. Ain't nobody going to know. Here go 30 million crypto. I don't know where that came from. Here you go.

quotes.speaker: Iman Shumpert
quotes.summary_phrase: Kawhi Leonard's injury rehab and team payment issues
quotes.excerpt: Do you think Kawhi was kind of being a little slow with some of the rehab?

text_blocks.speaker: Arhii Shumpert
text_blocks.text: Do you think Kawhi was kind of being a little slow with some of the rehab though? Because there were rumors that like they were a little bit late with some of his money during the process of trying to get him the money. Does that give a player like leverage over you if they're not getting their payments on time?

text_blocks.speaker: Iman Shumpert
text_blocks.text: I mean, I don't know. I'm not an owner. I'm telling you, I was not given that.

quotes.speaker: Iman Shumpert
quotes.summary_phrase: Iman Shumpert clarifies his hypothetical role in front office
quotes.excerpt: Just in case I do want to become an owner or a GM, I just want y'all to know.
quotes.quote: Just in case I do want to become an owner or a GM, I just want y'all to know my brother is putting this hypothetical in my lap. I have not broken any rules. I am not under investigation for anything.

quotes.speaker: Iman Shumpert
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James' potential impact on Clippers' roster
quotes.excerpt: But Bron's coming here next year.
quotes.quote: But Bron's coming here next year. Yeah, whoever we need, yeah, yeah, come on.

quotes.speaker: Iman Shumpert
quotes.summary_phrase: Clippers are willing to pay under the table for talent
quotes.excerpt: The Clippers not only will pay, they'll give you some under the table too.
quotes.quote: If you was the top free agent and now you know the Clippers not only will pay, they'll give you some under the table too. You might get some tax-free out of this. You telling me you as a free agent, that wouldn't hype you? I would be hyped. I would make y'all pay double under the table.

quotes.speaker: Iman Shumpert
quotes.summary_phrase: Lawrence Frank's role in Clippers' front office controversies
quotes.excerpt: Lawrence Frank, by the way, you bogus as hell.
quotes.quote: Lawrence Frank, by the way, you bogus as hell. They say he gave up his, he gave up notes. Like years worth of notes and they pressed him. That's what I'm saying, they pressed him. They had him up against the wall.
